html:
How to Enroll

Begin your journey in four simple steps.

Sign up using your email or institutional single sign-on (SSO). Verify your identity to gain access to the student dashboard.

Browse our catalog of over 500 accredited courses. Filter by skill level, duration, and industry relevance.

Process your tuition fee through our secure gateway, or apply your institutional voucher code at checkout.

Access your materials immediately. Join the community forums and introduce yourself to your cohort.
